verdict_reason: The one-line switch to packagesApply(entry.commodityCode) is correct and tested; a rationale comment on get that describes the removal module remains.

todos.issue: The comment above get (lines 65-69) is rationale and describes another module: 'the same rule the removal applies on the way out, applied on the way in, so a browser Back, a refresh or a bookmark cannot land on an empty details page'. A comment describes only the lines below it; the redirect-on-empty rule is already stated by the code and by the test 'Should send a details load with no commodities back to the commodity question'.
todos.fix: Must: get carries no comment, or only one that describes its own lines; the reasoning about Back/refresh/bookmark lives in docs or the behaviour spec. One way: delete the comment; extract the empty check to a named helper such as redirectToCommodityQuestion if the body needs saying.
